### ST17 {title="ST17 recurrence hits by SVTYPE"}

```{r plot-st17}
#| eval: !expr nrow(pass2_long) > 0

# Map each SVTYPE. the matching name_ST17_<SVTYPE> column
st17_cols <- c(BND = "name_ST17_BND",
               DEL = "name_ST17_DEL",
               DUP = "name_ST17_DUP",
               INS = "name_ST17_INS",
               INV = "name_ST17_INV")

# rlang-patterns: parameterize over the (SVTYPE, ST17 column) pair using
# tidyselect's .data[[ ]] to look up the column by string name per group.
# Uses pass2_clean (not pass2_long) so ST17 SVTYPE-mismatch blanking and
# BND partner-chromosome validation are already applied.
plot3_data <- imap_dfr(st17_cols, function(col_name, svtype) {
  if (!col_name %in% names(pass2_clean)) return(tibble())
  pass2_clean |>
    filter(SVTYPE == svtype) |>
    mutate(has_st17_hit = is_meaningful(.data[[col_name]])) |>
    count(SAMPLE, has_st17_hit, name = "n") |>
    mutate(SVTYPE = svtype, .before = 1)
})

p3 <- ggplot(plot3_data,
             aes(x = SAMPLE, y = n, fill = has_st17_hit,
                 text = paste0("<b>Sample:</b> ", SAMPLE,
                               "<br><b>SVTYPE:</b> ", SVTYPE,
                               "<br><b>", ifelse(has_st17_hit, "ST17 Hit", "ST17 Miss"), "</b>",
                               "<br><b>Variants:</b> ", n))) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  facet_wrap(~ SVTYPE, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "viridis", begin = 0.2, end = 0.85,
                       name = "ST17 hit?",
                       labels = c(`TRUE` = "Hit", `FALSE` = "Miss")) +
  labs(title    = "ST17 recurrence-BED hits by SVTYPE",
       subtitle = "Per-sample variants overlapping the ST17 T-ALL recurrence BED, by SV type",
       x = NULL, y = "Variant count") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5))

ggplotly(p3, tooltip = "text") |> config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```

### VAF {title="VAF / AF metric distributions"}

```{r plot-vaf-dist}
#| eval: !expr nrow(pass2_long) > 0


# somatic-signal. gnomAD_SV_AF and TUMOUR_AF are comma-joined multi-overlap tuples; take the max as the population-frequency / tumor-signal
parse_max_af <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || !nzchar(x)) return(NA_real_)
  vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_split(x, ",")[[1]]))
  vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]
  if (length(vals) == 0) NA_real_ else max(vals)
}

vaf_metrics <- pass2_clean |>
  mutate(
    hVAF_HP1      = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_split_fixed(hVAF, ",", 3)[, 1])),
    hVAF_HP2      = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_split_fixed(hVAF, ",", 3)[, 2])),
    VAF_num       = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(VAF)),
    gnomAD_AF_max = vapply(gnomAD_SV_AF, parse_max_af, numeric(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE),
    TUMOUR_AF_max = vapply(TUMOUR_AF,    parse_max_af, numeric(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
  ) |>
  select(SAMPLE, ID, SVTYPE, driver_tier,
         `Severus VAF`            = VAF_num,
         `Severus hVAF (HP1)`     = hVAF_HP1,
         `Severus hVAF (HP2)`     = hVAF_HP2,
         `SAVANA TUMOUR_AF (max)` = TUMOUR_AF_max,
         `gnomAD_SV_AF (max)`     = gnomAD_AF_max) |>
  pivot_longer(cols      = -c(SAMPLE, ID, SVTYPE, driver_tier),
               names_to  = "metric",
               values_to = "value") |>
  filter(!is.na(value))

p_vaf <- vaf_metrics |>
  ggplot(aes(x = metric, y = value,
             color = as.factor(driver_tier),
             text  = paste0("<b>Sample:</b> ",  SAMPLE,
                            "<br><b>ID:</b> ",    ID,
                            "<br><b>SVTYPE:</b> ", SVTYPE,
                            "<br><b>Driver tier:</b> T", driver_tier,
                            "<br><b>", metric, ":</b> ", round(value, 4)))) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.15,
               color = "grey40", fill = "grey85", show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, alpha = 0.75, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`1` = "#2CA02C", `2` = "#D68910", `3` = "#6c757d"),
                     name   = "Driver tier",
                     labels = c(`1` = "T1 (ST17)",
                                `2` = "T2 (Candidate)",
                                `3` = "T3 (Other)")) +
  labs(title    = "VAF / AF metric distributions",
       subtitle = "Boxplots summarize distribution; points are individual pass2 SVs colored by driver_tier",
       x = NULL, y = "Allele frequency") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

ggplotly(p_vaf, tooltip = "text") |> config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```

### Read depth {title="Supporting read-depth distributions"}

```{r plot-read-support}
#| eval: !expr nrow(pass2_long) > 0

# Three read-support metrics — Severus reference reads (DR), Severus variant reads (DV), and SAVANA TUMOUR_READ_SUPPORT. Higher DV / TUMOUR_READ_SUPPORT. higher confidence in the somatic call. 
read_metrics <- pass2_clean |>
  mutate(across(c(DR, DV, TUMOUR_READ_SUPPORT),
                ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x)))) |>
  select(SAMPLE, ID, SVTYPE, driver_tier,
         `Severus DR (ref reads)`      = DR,
         `Severus DV (variant reads)`  = DV,
         `SAVANA TUMOUR_READ_SUPPORT`  = TUMOUR_READ_SUPPORT) |>
  pivot_longer(cols      = -c(SAMPLE, ID, SVTYPE, driver_tier),
               names_to  = "metric",
               values_to = "reads") |>
  filter(!is.na(reads), reads > 0)

p_reads <- read_metrics |>
  ggplot(aes(x = metric, y = reads, color = SVTYPE,
             text = paste0("<b>Sample:</b> ",  SAMPLE,
                           "<br><b>ID:</b> ",    ID,
                           "<br><b>SVTYPE:</b> ", SVTYPE,
                           "<br><b>Driver tier:</b> T", driver_tier,
                           "<br><b>", metric, ":</b> ", reads, " reads"))) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.15,
               color = "grey40", fill = "grey85", show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0, alpha = 0.75, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = svtype_colors, name = "SVTYPE") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title    = "Supporting read-depth distributions",
       subtitle = "Boxplots per read-support metric; points are pass2 SVs colored by SVTYPE (log10 y-axis)",
       x = NULL, y = "Read count (log10)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))

ggplotly(p_reads, tooltip = "text") |> config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```

## Row {height="55%"}

### SV pass2 table {title="SV pass2 variant table" fill="true"}

```{r pass2-table}
#| eval: !expr nrow(pass2_long) > 0
#| column: screen-inset

# Display columns for the DT: full schema minus RE_gene
# driver prioritization.
display_cols <- c(
  "SAMPLE", "sample_id", "driver_tier", "SVTYPE", "DETAILED_TYPE", "ALT",
  "breakpoint", "CytoBand_display", "has_mate", "SVLEN", "CALLER",
  "Gene_name_display", "Candidate_genes", "ST17_hit",
  "AnnotSV_ranking_score", "ACMG_class",
  "VAF", "hVAF", "DR", "DV", "TUMOUR_READ_SUPPORT", "TUMOUR_AF",
  "ClinVar_SV_CLNSIG"
)
# sample_id (friendly cohort label) is joined in from sample_metadata via
# merge_sample_metadata() earlier — silently absent when no metadata CSV.
display_cols <- intersect(display_cols, names(pass2_clean))

# Sort: driver_tier ascending (T1 first), tier_score descending. higher-recurrence / more-candidates / higher-AnnotSV-rank first 


pass2_display <- pass2_clean |>
  arrange(driver_tier, desc(tier_score), SVTYPE, SAMPLE) |>
  select(all_of(display_cols))

# svtype_colors palette is defined in the load-pass2 chunk
svtype_col_js <- which(names(pass2_display) == "SVTYPE") - 1L

# Build a JS render callback that wraps each SVTYPE cell value in a
# pill-shaped span with an INLINE style attribute.
# overrides cyborg theme's dark-mode cell defaults AND the broader white-bg
# `!important` rules in the dt-readability chunk above
svtype_render_js <- DT::JS(sprintf(
  "function(data, type, row) {
     if (type !== 'display' || data == null || data === '') return data;
     var colors = %s;
     var c = colors[data] || '#6c757d';
     return '<span style=\"background-color:' + c + ';color:#ffffff;' +
            'font-weight:bold;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;' +
            'display:inline-block;min-width:36px;text-align:center;\">' +
            data + '</span>';
   }",
  jsonlite::toJSON(as.list(svtype_colors), auto_unbox = TRUE)
))

# driver_tier badge palette  
tier_colors <- c(`1` = "#2CA02C", `2` = "#D68910", `3` = "#6c757d")
tier_col_js <- which(names(pass2_display) == "driver_tier") - 1L
tier_render_js <- DT::JS(sprintf(
  "function(data, type, row) {
     if (type !== 'display' || data == null || data === '') return data;
     var colors = %s;
     var c = colors[String(data)] || '#6c757d';
     return '<span style=\"background-color:' + c + ';color:#ffffff;' +
            'font-weight:bold;padding:2px 10px;border-radius:10px;' +
            'display:inline-block;min-width:30px;text-align:center;\">' +
            'T' + data + '</span>';
   }",
  jsonlite::toJSON(as.list(tier_colors), auto_unbox = TRUE)
))

DT::datatable(
  pass2_display,
  escape     = FALSE,
  filter     = "top",
  rownames   = FALSE,
  width      = "100%",
  extensions = c("Buttons", "RowGroup"),
  options    = list(
    dom        = "Bfrtip",
    buttons    = c("csv", "excel"),
    pageLength = 15,
    scrollX    = TRUE,
    autoWidth  = TRUE,
    # Group rows by driver_tier — one T1/T2/T3 header bar.
    rowGroup   = list(dataSrc = tier_col_js),
    # Initial sort: driver_tier ASC keeps rowGroup buckets contiguous; secondary sort of AnnotSV_ranking_score DESC within each tier 
    order      = list(list(tier_col_js, "asc")),
    columnDefs = list(
      list(targets = svtype_col_js, render = svtype_render_js),
      list(targets = tier_col_js,   render = tier_render_js)
    )
  )
)
```

```{r snv-table}
            'T' + data + '</span>';
   }",
  jsonlite::toJSON(list(`1` = "#2CA02C", `2` = "#D68910", `3` = "#6c757d"),
                    auto_unbox = TRUE)
))

DT::datatable(
  snv_display,
  escape = FALSE, filter = "top", rownames = FALSE, width = "100%",
  extensions = c("Buttons", "RowGroup"),
  options = list(
    dom = "Bfrtip", buttons = c("csv", "excel"),
    pageLength = 15, scrollX = TRUE, autoWidth = TRUE,
    rowGroup = list(dataSrc = snv_tier_col_js),
    order = list(list(snv_tier_col_js, "asc")),
    columnDefs = list(list(targets = snv_tier_col_js, render = snv_tier_render_js))
  )
) |>
  # Round every VAF / allele-frequency column to 3 significant digits for
  # readability. Raw values (7+ decimals for gnomAD) survive in the cohort_snv.tsv
  # output for programmatic joins. `intersect(...)` guards against any of
  # these columns being absent in the display frame (e.g. gnomAD not run).
  DT::formatRound(
    columns = intersect(
      c("CLAIRSTO_VAF", "DEEPSOMATIC_VAF", "gnomADg_AF", "gnomADe_AF"),
      names(snv_display)
    ),
    digits = 3
  )
```

### Column {width="35%"}

#### Per-sample SNV summary {height="35%" title="Per-sample SNV summary"}

```{r snv-stats}
#| eval: !expr nrow(snv_long) > 0

snv_stats <- snv_long |>
  group_by(SAMPLE) |>
  summarise(
    `Total SNVs (pass2)`     = n(),
    `HIGH IMPACT`            = sum(IMPACT == "HIGH",     na.rm = TRUE),
    `MODERATE IMPACT`        = sum(IMPACT == "MODERATE", na.rm = TRUE),
    `ClinVar pathogenic`     = sum(grepl("[Pp]athogenic", CLNSIG), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

DT::datatable(
  snv_stats,
  filter = "top", rownames = FALSE,
  extensions = "Buttons",
  options = list(dom = "Bfrtip", buttons = c("csv", "excel"), pageLength = 25)
)
```

# Information

## Row {height="40%"}

### SV tier scheme {title="SV tier scheme"}

| Tier | Criterion | `tier_score` tie-breaker |
|---|---|---|
| **T1** | Any SVTYPE-matched `name_ST17_*` hit (empirical T-ALL recurrence BED). | max integer score across the SVTYPE-matched `score_ST17_*` cells. |
| **T2** | No ST17 hit, but candidate-gene overlap. | count of overlapping candidate genes. |
| **T3** | Neither ST17 nor candidate-gene, but survived pass2 vembrane gate. | `AnnotSV_ranking_score`. |

### CNA tier scheme {title="CNA tier scheme"}

| Tier | Criterion | `tier_score` tie-breaker |
|---|---|---|
| **T1** | Any of four SVTYPE-matched `name_ST19_Alterations.CNV.Recurrent_*` hits. | max integer score across the four SVTYPE-matched `score_ST19_*` |
| **T2** | Candidate-gene overlap. | count of overlapping candidate genes. |
| **T3** | Passed FILTER_CNA on other evidence. | `AnnotSV_ranking_score`. |

### SNV tier scheme {title="SNV tier scheme"}

| Tier | Criterion | `tier_score` tie-breaker |
|---|---|---|
| **T1** | OncoKB `ONC` = "Oncogenic" AND `SYMBOL` in candidate panel. | max(`CLAIRSTO_VAF`, `DEEPSOMATIC_VAF`). |
| **T2** | ClinVar `CLNSIG` pathogenic-leaning OR `SYMBOL` in candidate panel. | same VAF max. |
| **T3** | Passed FILTER_SNV on other evidence (SIFT/PolyPhen). | same VAF max. |

## Row {.collapsed}

### Pipeline notes {title="DISCO promotion + citations"}

**Only `driver_tier == 1` records** from all three variant tables are serialized into the DISCO plot's `mlst` array. The cohort DISCO plot on the Overview page shows the union of Tier-1 events across every sample. Per-sample DISCO HTMLs are written to `protein_paint_out/` under `results/sv_report/`.

The `params$candidate_genes` panel and customized BED files from `nextflow.config` are found in `results/annotsv/setupuseranno/` for down-stream investigations.

```{r disco-plot-status}
#| eval: !expr isTRUE(params$disco_enable)

if (!exists("mlst_all") || nrow(mlst_all) == 0) {
  cat("**No Tier-1 variants to display in DISCO plot.** ",
      "The plot is populated from driver_tier == 1 records across SV BNDs, ",
      "CNAs, and SNVs — none survived Tier-1 promotion in this run.", sep = "")
} else {
  n_snv <- sum(mlst_all$dt == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_cna <- sum(mlst_all$dt == 4, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_bnd <- sum(mlst_all$dt == 2, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("**Tier-1 variants displayed:** %d SNV point mutation(s), %d CNA segment(s), %d BND fusion(s). ",
              n_snv, n_cna, n_bnd),
      sprintf("Backend: `%s`. CNA `value` = log2(pmax(TCN, 0.25) / 2) — 0 = diploid, +1 = 4-copy amp, -1 = 1-copy loss.",
              params$proteinpaint_host), sep = "")
}
```
